disable_path: Do not select this profile. Only explicit invocation may dispatch native work; no fallback profile is accepted.
limitations: One explicitly selected paired Illumina non-UMI PHRED33 alignment profile; inputs are bounded by the current FASTQ intake.
Only the exact complete GRCh38.p14 RefSeq reference, five-file index, executor binaries and observed runtime library cohort are accepted.
Engineering artifact conformance does not establish general mapping accuracy, whole-genome throughput, coverage or callability.
Biological sample identity, variant calling and clinical validity are not assessed.
BWA-MEM2 upstream issue 262 remains unresolved; bounded boundary and supplementary regression evidence does not establish general parity with BWA.
No preprocessing, filtering, deduplication, GPU executor, automatic resource acquisition or hosted service is enabled.

parameters.program_header: Validate native provenance, then replace only operational PG command metadata with fixed ID:bwa-mem2 PN:bwa-mem2 VN:2.2.1 before sorting; preserve records, SQ and RG. Validate the pinned executor's input-ordinal read blocks and reciprocal primary links against the unsorted SAM before accepting the sorted BAM. Preserve native SAM bytes. Recover a solitary BAM Phred score 9 only from the exact clipped, oriented source occurrence when SAM represents it as missing QUAL; preserve all other record values and account for this proven SAM representation loss in full and indexed decodes.
parameters.read_group: Exactly one SAM-safe @RG uses declared_read_group_id for ID, declared_sample_id for SM, and fixed PL:ILLUMINA. declared_identity_binding_sha256 separately hashes declared_case_id, declared_sample_id, declared_specimen_id, declared_read_group_id and declared_run from the accepted input declaration. Case, specimen and run metadata are not serialized as @RG fields.
